text:
Alex K: Hey team — new project `redwood-shared-gpu` needs Shared VPC host enabled and GPU quota increases in us-west2: A100 8x, H100 4x, L4 16x. Project: projects/redwood-shared-gpu (billing already on). Can infra review and approve network/preflight? Need by Mon 09:00 PST. cc @Maria G @Simon P

Maria G: Quick Q — is this for Dedicated or private? Dedicated reserved pool or burstable? need predictability for throughput.

Alex K: Dedicated pool. We'll attach to host-vpc (Shared VPC host: redwood-core-net). We'll reserve capacity for canary + 3 prod nodes. ETA for deploy is next week.

Simon P: Two things: host project needs Compute Engine API + Service Networking enabled; also we need subnet secondary ranges if using GKE — but you're saying these are VMs, not GKE, right?

Alex K: VMs (inference nodes), not GKE. We'll use custom images, no GKE.

Lia T: ops-oncall: please confirm egress IP plan. If these VMs need static EIPs for allowlists, we'll need extra quota for external IP addresses + networking sign-off. Static EIPs add cost and ops overhead.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: FYI, suggestion: use Cloud NAT + Private Google Access unless customers require public IPs. Static EIPs add ~$0.01/hr per address and require allocation.

Maria G: Cost note — A100s in us-west2 on our current rates will bump monthly estimate by ~$9k for 8 units. Please confirm cost center and whether to proceed with on-demand vs reserved.

Alex K: Cost center: infra-prod-ml (CC-4102). This is a short-term test, no committed use discount yet.

quota-bot: quota-bot: Ticket #INC-2026 created to request increased quotas (A100:8 H100:4 L4:16) in us-west2. Link: https://go/redwood/quota/INC-2026

Simon P: Preflight checklist — attach a service account with `roles/compute.admin` to the project, and add firewall rules for management and inference ports. Example command:

```
 gcloud compute firewall-rules create redwood-inference-allow --project=redwood-shared-gpu \
   --allow tcp:22,tcp:443,tcp:7300-7400 --network=projects/redwood-core-net/global/networks/redwood-prod
```

Maria G: Approving network side from security: require tag-based firewalls, restrict SSH to bastion only, and ensure node metadata SSH keys are disabled. Also add SSH key rotation per docs: https://go/redwood/docs/ssh-rotation :thumbsup:

Alex K: Noted. I'll disable direct SSH on nodes and use the bastion for access.

Lia T: I can sign off from networking once quota ticket is approved and subnet ranges are confirmed. @Simon P can you confirm ephemeral IP strategy?

Simon P: We'll use Cloud NAT + ephemeral external IPs for image pulls. No static EIPs. Keeps cost and ops lower.

Maria G: Finance approves the quota increase pending cost center confirmation (received).

Alex K: Thanks all — ping me once INC-2026 is updated. I'll schedule the deploy for Tue 09:00 PST and run the canary then.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: once quotas are in, I'll run a smoke-run and post logs + perf numbers. I'll also add the project to oncall rotation and add an alert for kernel OOMs / preemption spikes.

Alex K: Great, appreciate it.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: NOTE: if H100 quota takes longer, we can start with A100/L4 mix and migrate later. :white_check_mark:
